findings.message: PlayShell now renders kid status summary from KidStatusReadModel, providing visibility into kid project status and progress.
ParentZoneShell now renders minimized dashboard summaries from ParentAuditReadModel and AIPerformanceReadModel, giving parents visibility into audit timeline and AI performance.
InboundMain wiring passes read-model ports into Play/Parent shells, ensuring proper dependency injection and component connectivity.
Hardening updates implemented: profile-isolated kid status read-model queries ensure data separation between different player profiles.
Data minimization enforced: recursive ad-tech key redaction applied to kid/parent/AI dashboard payloads, ensuring no advertising identifiers are exposed in telemetry data.
Improved AI performance metrics added: failed_executions and avg_latency_ms provide better visibility into AI system health, with deterministic fallback for robustness.
Contract test coverage added: kid_status_read_model_contract_test.gd, ai_performance_read_model_contract_test.gd, parent_audit_read_model_adapter_contract_test.gd all validate read model behavior.
Integration test added: test_dashboard_read_models_integration.gd provides end-to-end validation of dashboard read model integration.
Localization updated: data/localization/ui_pl.json includes Polish translations for dashboard UI elements.
Validation confirms all checks pass: run-inbound-shell-regression.sh, run-contract-tests.sh, and run-quality-gates.sh all execute successfully.
